description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'BuilderIntegrationTest' for testing the integration of tree building functionality within the Daux static documentation generator. It sets up a virtual filesystem, constructs a configuration, and asserts the correct creation and structure of a document tree including directories and content files.

classes.name: BuilderIntegrationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the integration of the tree building process in the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a virtual filesystem structure for testing.

methods.name: testCreateHierarchy
methods.description: Performs the test to verify that the directory and file structure is correctly built into a document tree, and assertions are checked on the structure and content.
